newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds higher, buyers sideline.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds higher, buyers sideline.

text.p: Higher Chicago futures overnight boosted UK meals and feeds prices on Wednesday.
High protein soymeal ex-mill was unchanged to one stg up while store were one stg higher.
"I think one or two people may be wishing they had jumped in on Tuesday when the market was falling, said one broker.
However, one trade was reported then spot high pro fetched 220.75 stg ex-store east coast.
The remainder of the market was mostly unchanged although rapemeal sellers ex-mill Hull and Liverpool were one stg lower.
